facts.says: air flow at full speed, anemometer at the outlet: 0.055 m3/s, 3.3 m3/min
facts.reference: the manufacturer's datasheet of scrubber-1, as delivered with the device

facts.says: single-pass removal efficiency, inlet and outlet CO2 at nominal bed temperature: 0.30 (a ratio, not a speed)
facts.reference: the manufacturer's datasheet of scrubber-1, as delivered with the device

facts.says: effective flow at full speed, Qe = flow x efficiency: 1.0 m3/min
facts.reference: the manufacturer's datasheet of scrubber-1, as delivered with the device

facts.says: response to a change of command: first order, time constant 3.33 min
facts.reference: the manufacturer's datasheet of scrubber-1, as delivered with the device

facts.says: with the board's speed guard (guard: speed in its state): while the cabin CO2 is ELEVATED, no speed below the minimum flow, 40 % by default (a speed command, not an efficiency)
facts.reference: the manufacturer's datasheet of scrubber-1, as delivered with the device

facts.says: with the board's speed guard (guard: speed in its state): in any cabin state, no speed below 30 % and no power off by software, only the crew's physical switch stops the scrubber (a speed command, not an efficiency)
facts.reference: the manufacturer's datasheet of scrubber-1, as delivered with the device

facts.says: after a stop, 10 min without removal while the beds return to their working values, then the first-order response; to measure on the scrubber
facts.reference: the manufacturer's datasheet of scrubber-1, as delivered with the device

facts.says: in the habitat (the bench motor at a scale of 300, an assumption to review): 158 W + 290 W x c at a command c above 0, about 254 W at 33 %; nothing when stopped
facts.reference: the manufacturer's datasheet of scrubber-1, as delivered with the device

facts.says: in the habitat, at full speed: about 448 W
facts.reference: the manufacturer's datasheet of scrubber-1, as delivered with the device

facts.says: with the board's atmospheric guard: a software stop names its minutes, 60 at most; the board restarts on its own at its end or earlier on its guard
facts.reference: the manufacturer's datasheet of scrubber-1, as delivered with the device
